chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ali b. Asad al-Asadi narrated to us in Ray in Rajab in the year 347 AH. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Ayyub narrated to me. He said: Ja’far b. Sunaid b. Dawud narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me. He said: Yusuf b. Muhammad b. al-Munkadir narrated to us from his father, from Jabir b. Abdullah. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The mother of Sulayman b. Dawud said to Sulayman (peace be upon him): "O my son! Beware of sleeping too much at night, for one who sleeps too much at night will be destitute [of good deeds] on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.فَقِيرًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: Destitute on the Day of Resurrection — lacking in good deeds
key_terms.كَثْرَة النَّوْمِ: Excessive sleep — sleeping beyond what is needed, neglecting worship

ai.seo_question: What did the mother of Prophet Sulayman advise him about sleeping at night?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys advice from the mother of Prophet Sulayman (Solomon) to her son, warning against excessive sleep at night. She explains that too much nighttime sleep leads to spiritual poverty on the Day of Judgment, implying that the night hours should be spent in worship and devotion. The original audience would have understood this as encouragement for night prayer (qiyam al-layl).

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. `Ali b. Asad al-Asadi narrated to us in Ray in Rajab in 347 AH. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Ayyub narrated to me. He said: Ja`far b. Sanid b. Dawud narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me. He said: Yusuf b. Muhammad al-Munkadir narrated to us from his father from Jabir b. `Abdullah.  He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

The mother of Sulayman b. Dawud said to Sulayman (as): “O my son! Beware of sleeping too much at night, for one who sleeps too much at night will be destitute [of good deeds] on the Day of Resurrection.”
